action_semantics: native-adjacent-tile-entry-v2; whole native frames, no changed physics
stop: win = first native level clear; death = native game-over after all initial/bonus lives; continue after intermediate deaths. Large watchdog bounds detect stalled runs and never count as wins.
loop_definition: repeated position sequence of period 2..64 with at least 2 distinct tiles, within one life and without consuming a pellet
loop_streak_definition: Consecutive decisions satisfying loop_definition. A non-cycle decision, pellet consumption or new life resets the streak. Report all raw cycles and the longest streak separately.
avoidable_death_definition: chosen action loses a life before entering the requested adjacent tile, while another legal action from identical native state and RNG does not; no claim of eventual survival
censoring: watchdog exits are stalled/incomplete failures, never wins or native game-overs; report separately and reject for teacher qualification
split_rule: seeds reserved for evaluation, disjoint from every packaged v1 data split; never use their trajectories for new training
generalization_scope: same classic maze, starting levels 1,2,3,5 and five seeds (20 full games per adapter); no held-out-layout or untested-level claim
